subject: Literature
title: Joseph Campbell and the Monomyth
description: A fast breakdown of Joseph Campbell and the Monomyth for builders.

hook.text: Joseph Campbell argued that every myth in every culture follows one universal story: the Hero's Journey.

buildup.text: The hero leaves home, faces trials, gains wisdom, and returns transformed. Campbell found this pattern everywhere.

discovery.text: His 1949 book The Hero with a Thousand Faces mapped the structure shared by myths across all civilizations.

twist.text: George Lucas explicitly used Campbell's monomyth to structure Star Wars, making myth a Hollywood formula.

climax.text: Critics argue the monomyth oversimplifies diverse cultures, but its influence on modern storytelling is undeniable.

punchline.text: One professor's theory built a galaxy far, far away.

quiz.question: How did Joseph Campbell's work influence popular culture?
options: He directed the first Star Trek film
George Lucas used his monomyth to structure Star Wars
He wrote the screenplay for The Lord of the Rings
